title.title: The Amazing Digital Circus
title.overview: A woman finds herself trapped in a virtual circus where she and five other humans are subject to the whims of a wacky AI ringmaster. In this digital purgatory they must face frightening NPCs and cope with their own personal traumas.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Trapped in the Digital Circus and desperate to leave, Pomni meets other humans transformed into cartoon characters – and Caine, the eccentric ringmaster.

episodes.name: Candy Carrier Chaos!
episodes.overview: The gang is tasked with pursuing syrup bandits in a candy kingdom; Pomni helps a digital outlaw work through his sticky identity crisis.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Mildenhall Manor
episodes.overview: Kinger and Pomni explore a haunted mansion for an adventure filled with monsters, ghosts and therapy sessions.

episodes.name: Fast Food Masquerade
episodes.overview: The crew spends the day working at Spudsy’s burger chain. Can they handle a whole day of menial labour?

episodes.name: Untitled
episodes.overview: We aren't actually sure what this episode is about.

episodes.name: They All Get Guns
episodes.overview: Caine arms the crew for a brutal survival game, where teams of two must hunt for weapons and endure three "deaths" to be declared the winners.

episodes.name: Beach Episode
episodes.overview: The gang heads to the beach for a day under the sun, but unsettling revelations begin to reveal cracks in Caine's circus.

episodes.name: hjsakldfhl
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of Caine's latest adventure, the ringmaster's sanity starts to falter...

episodes.name: Remember
episodes.overview: As their reality unravels, the cast uncovers the truth behind the Digital Circus and its history.

similar.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
similar.overview: Follow Captain Christopher Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the years before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise, as they explore new worlds around the galaxy.

similar.title: Maddie + Triggs
similar.overview: A little girl and her doggy best friend find music and adventure in the sounds of the everyday by really listening to the world around them.

similar.title: The Season
similar.overview: A group of friends in Hong Kong's elite boating scene find their summer getaway descending into betrayal and power plays as hidden agendas surface.

similar.title: Nurse the Dead
similar.subtitle: 2026 • PG
similar.overview: Tasked with saving LA’s most haunted hospital ward, a highly motivated Filipina nurse with a third eye must manage unruly ghosts, burned-out staff, and one judgmental “coworker” who knows her better than anyone should.

similar.title: D&D: Dungeon Masters
similar.overview: Dungeon Masters stars Jasmine Bhullar (DesiQuest, Dimension 20) as Dungeon Master, joined by Mayanna Berrin (Dispatch, The Dungeon Run), Christian Navarro (13 Reasons Why, Forgotten Realms), Neil Newbon (Baldur’s Gate III), and Devora Wilde (Baldur’s Gate III) and features an all-original score by five-time, Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone.

similar.title: Grave Conversations
similar.overview: An unforgettable journey into the depths of human existence, while David Dastmalchian guides his guests through discussions that delve into personal reflections on mortality, legacy, and the afterlife, all while lying down in Titan caskets.

similar.title: The Studio
similar.overview: Paul, an underdog music producer, juggles family life and artistic dreams by working out of his home studio with a rotating cast of eccentric clients, creating original music and navigating hilarious family drama along the way.

similar.title: The Long Pour
similar.overview: The Long Pour is a late 1920s New York Prohibition-era crime drama following the Italian-American Rinaldi family, who quietly control one of the city’s most sophisticated bootlegging empires. Led by Don Salvatore “Tore” Rinaldi, his wife, and his 5 sons, the family profits by maintaining and controlling Prohibition and carefully balancing supply, scarcity, and corruption to keep illegal alcohol highly lucrative.

similar.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
similar.subtitle: 2026 • TV-PG
similar.overview: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

similar.title: Mystery Files
similar.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

similar.title: Underverse
similar.overview: Sans traverses across the multiverse to stop a powerful threat that had lost everything, while meeting more variations of himself along the way.

similar.title: Dirty Business
similar.overview: Two amateur detectives in an Oxfordshire village discover dying fish in their river. When they contact the water company for answers, the company's odd, evasive response prompts them to launch an investigation that continues today.

similar.title: Dimension 20
similar.overview: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.
